dti.title: DTI (debt-to-income)
dti.body: Percentage of monthly net income spent on debt payments. Healthy ≤ 20%; risky > 36%.

housing.title: Housing ratio
housing.body: Percentage of net income spent on housing (rent or mortgage + basic utilities). Recommended ≤ 30%.

emergency.title: Emergency fund
emergency.body: Months of fixed expenses and minimum debt payments covered by liquid assets. Healthy range: 3 to 6 months.

savings.title: Savings rate
savings.body: Percentage of net income directed to savings goals and recurring contributions.

healthScore.title: Financial health score
healthScore.body: A 0–100 score combining four components: DTI, emergency fund, housing ratio, and savings rate.

error.title: Save failed
error.quotaExceeded: Browser storage is full. Your data is still in memory but won't be saved until space is freed.
error.invalidState: In-memory data is invalid. Retry or review the form.

load.title: Couldn't load your saved data
load.invalidJson: We couldn't read the data saved in this browser: the file is corrupted or incomplete. Your on-screen values are the defaults — save any change to overwrite the damaged file.
load.invalidState: The saved data is invalid for the current version. Your on-screen values are the defaults.
load.dismissedNote: You can keep using the app with default values.

savings.noRateConfigured: Set an annual rate on a savings or investment asset to see the compound growth projection.

annualRatePercent.label: Annual rate (EAR %)
annualRatePercent.hint: Effective Annual Rate between 0% and 100%. Applies to savings and investment assets.

apr.label: Effective Annual Rate (EAR)
apr.tooltip: APR here means Effective Annual Rate, the Colombian Superfinanciera standard. Monthly rate uses (1 + EAR)^(1/12) − 1.

income.title: Start by registering your income
income.body: Without income configured the dashboard cannot compute your financial health.

expenses.title: Add your fixed expenses
expenses.body: With your fixed expenses we can compute your DTI and monthly projection.

suggestion.title: Does the transport allowance apply?
suggestion.body: By law in Colombia, employees earning ≤ 2 SMMLV receive a transport allowance ($200,000/month in 2025).

notice.aboveThreshold: Your salary is above 2 SMMLV — the transport allowance no longer applies.
